title: Around the Pac-12: Colorado State, Utah State face top 25 foes
text:
A look at this week’s games.
Boise State running back Sire Gaines runs the ball during the first half of an NCAA college football game against Oregon, Saturday, Sept. 5, 2026, in Eugene, Ore.
Boise State trailed Memphis 20-17 at halftime, then pitched a shutout during a 21-point second-half comeback. The Broncos defense forced three punts and two turnovers on downs over the final two periods. … Broncos running back Dylan Riley was the Doak Walker National Running Back of the Week and Pac-12 Offensive Player of the Week after rushing for a career-high 206 yards against Memphis.
Riley had a 71-yard carry that was the Broncos’ longest play from scrimmage this season … Boise State has the nation’s best winning percentage since moving to FBS 30 years ago. The next best marks over the three decades are by Ohio State , Alabama , Michigan and Notre Dame . Colorado State running back Mel Brown had 171 yards rushing against Southern Utah, most of it coming on 73- and 80-yard runs.
The 73-yarder went for a touchdown. The 80-yarder was the longest in program history without going for a TD. … The Rams are tied with Memphis for the most explosive plays over 70 yards and over 50 yards this season. … Colorado State’s eight turnovers gained are tied with New Mexico for first in the nation.
Fresno State’s win was keyed by a 32-point second quarter, the first time since 2012 the Bulldogs produced that many points in the second quarter against an FBS opponent. They had 35 in a 69-14 win against Colorado. … For only the third time in 40 years, the Bulldogs had a 300-yard passer , a 100-yard rusher and two 100-yard receivers in the same game.
… Fresno State defensive back Simeon Harris’ interception against Sacramento State was the seventh of his career, ranking third among active FBS players. Oregon State leads the series against Montana 12-2-2, although the Grizzlies have won the past two meetings . … Oregon State quarterback Braden Atkinson leads the nation with 394.5 passing yards a game, and wide receiver Jesse Legree leads the nation in receiving yards with 188 yards a game. .
… The Oregon State roster includes players from 26 states, led by California , Oregon and Washington . The SDSU-UCLA game was 0-0 at halftime, marking the first time the Bruins were held scoreless in the first half since 1989 against Tennessee. … The Aztecs’ seven-game active home winning streak is tied for seventh in the nation. Indiana leads the way with a 17-game home winning streak.
… SDSU running back Lucky Sutton has not fumbled the ball in 333 career touches . Texas State and North Texas have played 40 times over the years. North Texas leads the series 29-8-2, although Texas State won the last meeting in the 2024 First Responders Bowl. … It seems odd for Texas State to be favored by a field goal with North Texas coming off a 44-6 win over UNLV.
… Texas State rushed for 289 yards against UTSA, including a career-high 149 yards from Torrance Burgess Jr. The run game is quite a complement to quarterback Brad Jackson, the Pac-12’s top-rated QB coming into the season. This is the 114th meeting between Utah State and Utah, which leads the series 80-29-4. The Aggies have lost eight straight road games against Utah since a 21-14 win in 1997.
… Utah State has turned the ball over seven times in two games, but the Aggies’ defense has allowed only 13 points off those giveaways. … Utah’s roster includes wide receiver Braden Pegan, who had 60 receptions for 926 yards and five touchdowns last season — for Utah State. Washington State is favored this week by more points than any other Pac-12 team, but the 37 1/2-point spread does not rank in the top 10 this week. It’s 11th.
Tops is Oregon by 57 1/2 points over Portland State. … The spread is more than twice as many points as the Cougars have scored this season. Their 17 points have come on a rushing touchdown, an interception returned for a touchdown and a field goal … This is the 15th game against an FBS opponent in Duquesne history. It is 1-13, the lone win a 28-26 victory over Ohio in 2021.
